meta.title: FSM audit: toy job queue
meta.scope: Entity: job (jobs.py). One Scout run, read-only, code was not executed.

summary.headline: 3 bugs and 1 risk in the job lifecycle; the main cause is writes without a from-guard.
bullets: A late failure can overwrite a finished job (no guard in fail).
The watchdog resets jobs by elapsed time only and acts as a second writer.
retry_failed resets any state, including done, with no attempts cap.

findings.title: A late failure overwrites a finished job
findings.claim: fail() writes status='dead' with no from-guard, so a worker that fails after the job was completed by another worker turns done into dead.
path: lease expires and the watchdog returns the job to pending
worker B claims and completes it (done)
worker A fails and calls fail(): status becomes dead

evidence.quote: update jobs set status='dead' where id=?

findings.impact: A completed job is reported as dead; its result is hidden.
findings.refuted_if: a row lock, version column or status condition exists in the caller's transaction
findings.test_idea: A leases; expire lease; B completes; A fails; expect done.
findings.reach: needs a slow worker and an expired lease; plausible under load.

findings.title: retry_failed resets any state and has no attempts cap
findings.claim: retry_failed sets pending for any job, including done, and nothing bounds the number of attempts.
path: an operator or script calls retry_failed
job returns to pending and runs again

evidence.quote: update jobs set status='pending' where id=?

findings.impact: Resurrection of terminal states; poison jobs can loop forever.
findings.refuted_if: callers only pass ids of dead jobs and a cap is enforced elsewhere
findings.test_idea: complete a job; call retry_failed; expect refusal.

skeptic.reason: no guard and no cap in the module

findings.known_to_owners: A comment in the module says retries are manual and "accepted for now".

findings.title: Watchdog acts on elapsed time only
findings.claim: reap_expired returns processing jobs to pending when the lease expired; a slow but alive worker still holds the job and will write a result.
findings.refuted_if: workers fence writes by an epoch or the lease is renewed by heartbeat
findings.test_idea: A holds, watchdog resets, B claims, A completes: expect a refusal for A.

skeptic.reason: no heartbeat or epoch in the module

findings.title: complete() ignores the rows-affected result
findings.claim: complete() uses a guarded update but never reads the result, so a refused completion is silent.
path: zero rows change, caller sees success
findings.impact: A result can be lost without a trace.
findings.refuted_if: a caller checks job status after complete()
findings.test_idea: complete() on a pending job: expect an error or a logged refusal.

absence.control: attempts written at jobs.py:15 was found
absence.result: attempts is written at 2 lines and read at 0: nothing compares it with a cap

findings.title: A job with attempts above the cap is still claimable
findings.claim: claim() does not compare attempts with any limit.
findings.refuted_if: a cap exists in the caller
findings.test_idea: fail a job 10 times; expect dead.
